notes: Region-composition check for the real OnboardingWizard (its own `step` state defaults to 2, 'Modes & jurisdictions' — the artboard's own illustrated step, no forced navigation needed) inside AuthFrame, populated fixture aggregates via .discipline/rendering/audit/mounts.mjs['compose-onboarding'] — no live Supabase project reachable in this sandbox (DEVIATION-LOG.md).

This lane found NO composition defects — the wizard was already built carefully by a prior lane (OnboardingWizard.tsx's own header explains the 5→4-step replacement and every deviation, already logged). Artboard order confirmed present and in order: 4-pill stepper (Workspace done / Modes & jurisdictions active / Sectors / Briefing) -> 'Where do you move freight?' heading + scope copy -> Modes chip row -> Home jurisdictions chip grid + '+N more' -> Preview·your workspace today 4-tile band strip -> Skip for now / Continue → Sectors footer.
Step 4 'Briefing' has no artboard yet (operator ruling, dispatch instruction) — out of this mount's and this lane's scope, left as built.

This lane's own mount needed one infrastructure fix to show real counts: OnboardingWizard.tsx's profile-prefill effect awaits `supabase.from("profiles")...` unconditionally on mount; the compose-login/signup `stub-supabase-browser-auth.mjs` (reused here) had no `.from` at all, which threw inside the effect before `setLoadingProfile(false)` ran, leaving the step-2 preview tiles stuck on their loading skeleton forever regardless of the `aggregates` fixture prop. Added the same empty-row `.from` shape the generic stub already carries — additive, does not change stub-supabase-browser-auth.mjs's signed-out `.auth` contract that /login and /signup depend on.
